title: Fribourg celebrate SBL title
description: Fribourg - Starwings 85-76 Fribourg are 2020/21 SBL champions. They beat Starwings at home court tonight to complete the sweep of the championship series. Fribourg led from the first minutes and controlled entire game increasing their lead in each quarter. It was a good game for American forward Sean Barnette (195-86, college: Wingate) who led his team to a victory with 16 points and 6 assists. The former international power forward Arnaud Cotture (203-95) contributed with 12 points, 7 rebounds and 4 assists for the winners. Five Fribourg players scored in double figures. American forward Nathan Krill (202-96, college: USF) answered with 17 points and 9 rebounds and Senegalese power forward Cheikh Sane (207-92, college: Marshall) added 17 points and 6 rebounds in the effort for Starwings.
